column1: # Coverage floors for dev/coverage.sh --check: script<TAB>minimum % (credited line coverage).

# on PRs that change scripts (#157): a PR that adds branches to a script must cover them, or it goes red.
# Set at the credited % (dev/coverage.sh, #147) rounded down, minus 1. Raise a floor in the PR that adds the tests.
